meta.source: Design/motion study clone of https://www.raycast.com/ (homepage + 7 main-nav pages); structure from CLONE_SPEC.md and PAGES_SPEC.md, components from src/. Content is original placeholder.
meta.status: built — all 8 routes implemented; reconciled against src/pages/

categories.SHOWCASE: Large product mockup or media showcase
categories.FEATURE: Feature explanation blocks and section headings
categories.PROOF: Social proof: testimonials, community, logos, quotes

nav.navbar.description: Fixed glass navbar: wordmark, primary route links, Log in / Download actions, hamburger menu below the 880px breakpoint.

footer.footer.description: Site footer: link columns, newsletter row, legal line, decorative background art (art prop selects cube or windows variant).

hero.home.description: Homepage hero: WebGL glass-bars background with CSS fallback, animated announcement pill, display heading, sub-text, download actions.

hero.page.description: Shared secondary-page hero: pill, heading, subtitle, actions and optional art/media slot; variants sheen / store / teams / plain set background and sizing.
hero.page.scope: Secondary product pages that open with a standard page hero (store, pro, teams, AI, iOS).
hero.page.implementedBy: PageHero.jsx (Store/Pro/Teams/Ai/Ios pass their own art: StoreArt, ProArt, TeamsOrbit, IosHeroArt)

hero.windows-serif.description: Windows hero with serif display heading and embedded Windows download block.

hero.pricing-art.description: Decorative soft-glow image positioned behind the pricing toggle; no animation.

showcase.shortcuts-frame.description: Framed macOS-style launcher mockup with dock, star-dot border and auto-advancing scripted slide reel.

showcase.time-keyboard.description: Text column beside a masked 3D keyboard grid whose feature keys light up in a staggered sequence on scroll-in.

showcase.game-launcher-marquee.description: Slow infinite marquee of game-launcher tiles paired with a split feature.

showcase.phone-composite.description: Phone mockup composited over a wide band image.

showcase.full-bleed-image.description: Full-bleed wide image under a section title.

catalog.extensions-carousel.description: Extensions carousel with sliding category pill, snap-scrolling cards, slide-in stagger and pager buttons.

catalog.extension-reel.description: Bare extension card reel (no category tabs or pager) with centered two-tone title and browse link.

catalog.featured-grid.description: Featured extensions block: headings over a three-card grid.

catalog.store-grid.description: Paginated grid of store extension cards.

catalog.template-grid.description: Grid of team templates under a centered lead.

feature.ai-bento.description: Homepage-style AI section: header plus one wide and two half cards in a bento grid with in-card scripted workflow.

feature.ai-card-grid.description: Masonry grid of AI cards of varying heights.

feature.ai-wide-visual.description: AI header over a single wide card visual.

feature.ai-card-pairs.description: AI header over a two-by-two card grid with an arrow link.

feature.ai-chip-tabs.description: Row of chip tabs switching the AI stage below the hero.

feature.byok-row.description: Bring-your-own-key row under the AI card grid.

feature.model-tabs.description: Tabbed model picker with detail panel in a wide shell.

feature.automation.description: Automation cards: snippet typing composer, quick links mock and hotkey press showcase.

feature.feature-wall.description: Clickable feature text wall with crossfading screenshot frame and timed progress bar.

feature.developer-grid.description: Hairline developer/API grid with dotted figure cells and per-figure scroll animations.

feature.section-title.description: Standalone section heading (optional eyebrow and body) introducing the content that follows.
feature.section-title.scope: Pro and iOS pages, repeated within a page.

feature.centered-lead.description: Centered heading and short body introducing a section on older-style pages.

feature.split.description: Text column beside a visual; side and head style vary by prop.
feature.split.scope: Pro, teams, AI, Windows and iOS pages, often several per page.

feature.media-card-grid.description: Grid of feature cards each pairing a visual with text; pro / windows / ios variants.

feature.hotkeys-banner.description: Wide banner showing a hotkey combination.

proof.testimonials.description: Person carousel with auto-advance and click-select, plus quote panel and highlight grid.

proof.community.description: Community section: two social cards plus a draggable video thumbnail strip.

proof.social-cards.description: The two community social cards on their own, without the video strip.

proof.quote-strip.description: Strip of short user quotes with chip highlights.

pricing.plans.description: Plan section: monthly/yearly toggle, tier cards, tier switch and enterprise card.
pricing.plans.scope: Pricing, Pro, AI and Teams pages.

pricing.compare-table.description: Full feature comparison table across tiers.

faq.accordion.scope: Pricing, Pro, AI, Windows and iOS pages.

cta.final-keyboard.description: Final call to action over a large keyboard whose Cmd and Space keys glow at high visibility.

cta.download.description: Platform download block (mac / windows / ios variants; iOS adds a QR card).

cta.windows-final.description: Windows closing call to action: centered lead over the Windows download block, no keyboard art.
